structured_output.what_is_happening: A cluster of at least 10 same-name 'slopcannon' tokens were launched over the past ~2 hours. They all ride on @boneGPT's AI content tool 'slopcannon', which is in beta right now and gets organic mentions on X. This token (A2Lw…) came off a Meteora virtual curve and migrated at creation. It is about 18 minutes old. It pumped about 4x, then fell about 50% in the last 5 minutes. The website link in its metadata points to a different contract (55Vr…), so this looks like a copycat pointing at another token's page. Wallets: 2,039 unique buyers against only 83 unique sellers, with 1,488 of those buyers in a single 15-minute window. That lopsided pattern looks like bot or airdrop-style buying. One unlabeled wallet holds 80% of supply, 99.99% of the LP is unlocked, and the creator's token status is 'creator_close'.

token_connection.why_this_token: None found beyond the name. Its own website field points to the 55Vr… contract, not to itself.
token_connection.competing_tokens: There are 10+ same-name tokens. BuQB… has a higher market cap ($380k) and 55Vr… has the most volume ($767k h1) and is the one referenced by the usepaid.app link. Several others have already gone to zero liquidity.

authenticity.evidence: 2,039 unique buyers against 83 sellers, with 1,488 buyers in 15 minutes, suggests many small bot or bundled buys. GMGN shows 15 bundlers and 10 snipers. One wallet holds 80% of supply and LP is unlocked. The clone-spam pattern repeats across 10+ same-name tokens.
authenticity.uncertainty: The 80% holder could be a Meteora pool or vault account that RugCheck didn't label. GMGN reports top10 at only 10%, which contradicts RugCheck.
